title: Route support tickets with one switch expression

blocks.text: The help desk is moving its ticket routing out of a rules spreadsheet and into code. Each ticket has a category and a severity from 1 (most urgent) to 4, and lands in one team's queue:

rows: the on-call engineer, when the severity is 1 or 2

blocks.text: A page is recorded by adding `"on-call: <ticket id>"` or `"security-lead: <ticket id>"` to the list the router was built with.
Write `route(...)` in `src/main/java/practice/TicketRouter.java` as one `return switch`. A ticket pages at most one person, and only the one its row names. About ten lines in total.

cases.says: billing and refund tickets go to finance, feature requests and other tickets to product, and a security ticket to security with one page to the security lead
an outage goes to operations, pages on-call only at severity 1 or 2, and never runs on into the security handling

origin.section: A Block Arm Hands Out Its Value With yield; return and break Can't Leave a Switch Expression

concepts: Arrow labels never fall through, in a statement or an expression; colon labels fall through even in a switch expression, until a yield.
A block arm gives its value with yield; return and break out of a switch expression, and a block arm without a value, are compile errors.
